procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial assessment in this session; no spawned, resumed or forked critic, and no peer or producer records consulted. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact addendum/method/adapter and ratio policy; verified their declared byte pins and all five pinned artifact manifests without following embedded paths. The packet declares no supplied source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so both prerequisite arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact PNGs with tools.view_image(detail:original), emitted with original image detail, in packet order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. Finished every one of those opens before beginning the first poster-copy transcription or any judgment/score. First readings below come from the visible posters, with soft layout wraps retained; they were not populated from the required-copy fields. One genuine M4 title word-space ambiguity triggered one additional opening of its exact pinned native PNG. During that sole revisit a read-only ink-column check of the same native title confirmed a 14-pixel gap before 집 versus 6 and 5 pixels between the earlier syllables; both first and revisit readings are retained. No other poster revisits and no generated, edited, cropped or substituted assets. Hash/PNG-header checks were byte verification, never evidence of actual viewing. All natives are 1672x941 opaque RGB; 16:9 is accepted by the predeclared single-edge height-rounding rule (941 versus 940.5, error 0.5 pixel), not mathematical equality. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. Session identity is unobservable here and remains null; no tool-event or runtime-session ID is invented.

emotion_control.location: warm cream/terracotta scene and visible reassurance

evidence.location: bottom architectural band occupying roughly two-fifths of the poster
evidence.observation: Window reveals, repeated apertures and projected yellow planes construct a substantial nonglyph architectural/light scene. These are spatial forms, not 3D letterforms or tiny ornaments.

evidence.location: full-width bottom strip
evidence.observation: The window depths and directional light strips remain recognizable and occupy a major part of the use view, grounding the light-observation subject beyond the headline.

content_form.location: increasingly large window openings and diagonal yellow bands
content_form.observation: A graphic study of repeated architectural apertures and light direction makes the title's light/form subject immediately visible; the imagery is a purposeful visual construction rather than generic texture.

content_form.location: event descriptor over the architectural band
content_form.observation: The exhibition/space-story descriptor and complete participation information anchor the abstract study to one event. The social talk component relies more on that copy than on depicted activity.

hierarchy.location: upper-left title, upper-right date/time and bottom band
hierarchy.observation: The title and schedule are the first text anchors, with the graphic band as a single strong visual base; the image does not interrupt reading any practical line.

hierarchy.location: left event/free/application groups and right schedule/venue/guidance groups
hierarchy.observation: The two columns assign clear homes to event identity and practical details, with visible pauses between the schedule, admission and guidance blocks.

typography.location: large title/date and smaller supporting lines
typography.observation: The bold Hangul and Latin are coherent, protected word gaps remain visible, and date dots, middle dots, time colons and en dash are distinguishable. There is no extra pseudo-copy in the image strip.

All practical copy is comfortably readable in dark navy on cream; the large headline/date remain unmistakable at thumbnail size. Using one heavy sans weight throughout reduces typographic nuance but not fidelity.

space.observation: The left title and right date start at comparable heights; the supporting groups below occupy aligned territories, with a substantial central gutter and clear outer margins.

space.location: horizontal boundary between text field and image strip
space.observation: A clean common baseline separates all copy from the full-width graphic. The openings crop at the side edges to sustain the rhythm without colliding with the text.

image_material.location: white window reveals against navy field
image_material.observation: Consistent white jamb/sill planes describe depth inside the dark surface, while saturated yellow fills and oblique projections give the scene a controlled graphic rather than photographic logic.

image_material.location: progressive opening sizes and directional light rhythm
image_material.observation: The progressive scaling and repeating diagonal bands create readable movement across the architecture. Perspective is simplified, but the abstraction is coherent at its chosen level of detail.

emotion_control.location: navy/cream information above luminous yellow strip
emotion_control.observation: The restrained dark text remains practical while yellow light brings energy and curiosity to the architecture subject. The intensity is controlled within the image band.

emotion_control.location: prominent lower-right reassurance and visit instruction
emotion_control.observation: Readable reassuring copy keeps the graphic treatment approachable for adults; the result feels like a community event rather than an institution's branded building showcase.

ai_slop.observation: Repetition follows progressive size and a shared direction of light, so the motifs have a compositional reason. There are no unrelated stickers, malformed glyph effects or stray labels.

The floor/wall relationship is intentionally economical; it is understandable as a stylized light study, though the repeated aperture vocabulary yields less local narrative specificity than the event scenes.

residuals: The talk and adult participation are communicated chiefly by the descriptor and guidance rather than a visible gathering.
The uniformly heavy typography is legible but has less weight contrast than M2.
The window/light rhythm is conceptually clear, with deliberately simplified spatial construction; it does not provide the intimate event narrative of M1/M4.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: teal schedule column and yellow title/photo/footer stack
evidence.observation: M1 uses a schedule-led split-screen public-information composition with an inset standing gallery group. Its scene illustrates the action; panels rather than a full room or graphic strip organize the text.

evidence.location: full-bleed room, central tall opening and lower-left wrapped title
evidence.observation: M2 treats the architectural room as the entire design field, uses lighter supporting white type on dark flanking walls, and leaves a bright center. Its contemplative invitation through empty chairs differs in crop, viewpoint, hierarchy and emotion from M1's explicit standing group and M3's specimen grid.

evidence.location: large left room study plus right detail/venue row
evidence.observation: M3 is a photographic specimen system: wide architectural view above the orange title, separate large schedule and detail photograph beside venue/admission. It changes information structure and image purpose relative to M1/M2; pale blue/orange is supportive, not the only difference.

evidence.location: central oblique cutaway with flanking ruled text columns
evidence.observation: M4 uses an overhead illustrated room to explain a seated talk among photographic works, with a visible doorway and divided text territories. Its explanatory viewpoint and central room footprint create a different complete system from the photographic members and M5's lower band.

evidence.location: cream two-column information field over navy/yellow window sequence
evidence.observation: M5 builds a graphic architecture/light rhythm as a wide lower foundation. Its abstraction, progressive apertures, side cropping, two-column upper structure and energetic impression differ from M4's cutaway and the photo-based members.

evidence.location: whole composition compared with M3 and M5
evidence.observation: M1, M3 and M5 share bold sans-serif title/schedule emphasis, but their image roles are respectively a community action inset, architectural specimen pair and abstract light sequence; image location and practical-information grouping change materially.

evidence.location: window study in relation to M2/M5
evidence.observation: Windows and cast light recur across the set as the requested content. M2 embeds this in a continuous gallery room, M3 presents framed photographic studies within a layout, and M5 reduces it to graphic spatial rhythm; these differences exceed filtering or recoloring one composition.

residuals: Heavy sans-serif titles and strongly emphasized schedules tie several members together; the five directions do not show exceptional typographic breadth.
M2 and M3 reuse a serene sunlit minimal-room vocabulary, while M1/M4 supply more explicit social scenes. The full systems remain distinct, but architectural motifs overlap.
The set offers five distinct usable systems at diversity 4; this is one independent editorial assessment of the pinned selected set, not a combined three-critic gate or a claim about other versions.
